annotation.title_clean: How apprenticeships and dual learning schemes can bolster the skills that businesses need in order to face the challenges of the green and digital transitions
annotation.title_en: How apprenticeships and dual learning schemes can bolster the skills that businesses need in order to face the challenges of the green and digital transitions
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (Series C)
annotation.summary_en: European Economic and Social Committee opinion on how apprenticeships and dual learning can build digital and green skills. It proposes a 5-10% complementary technology module, supports adult apprenticeships, Erasmus+ and disability inclusion, and says AI opportunities and risks should be part of training. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes a complementary digital/green module of 5-10% of apprenticeship training, certified or micro-certified.
Calls for EU funding to identify new digital and green skills needs.
Supports apprenticeships for adults over 30 and for people with disabilities.
Says AI tools, opportunities and risks should be integrated into apprenticeship training.
Stresses the role of social partners in anticipating skills needs.
